Metadata.Title: Bloodborne
Metadata.Name: Fix: New Game crash (Mutex is not initialized)
Metadata.Author: GerasimosKan
Metadata.Note: New Game crashed as the opening movie started (deadinside28/bloodborne_pc#392): the movie's audio thread runs at once on a PC and locks a DLLightMutex before its owner initialised it. Lock, TryLock and Unlock now initialise the mutex themselves instead of panicking (Initialize does nothing when it already is).
